description: Change a site's operational settings. Only the fields you pass change. Browser identity, the proxy, the firewall token, GitHub and search-engine connections, and deleting the site stay in the dashboard.

aiTriage.description: Relvato AI triage of failed runs: label = each failure labelled needs attention / likely noise / repeat; hold = also hold back the instant alert of a confident likely-noise failure (never checkout, sign-in, uptime or security; still in the bell and digest); aside = also set that failure aside (out of the bell, digest and site health; the owner brings it back in the app); off = none (Pro and up; sends run details to Anthropic)

challengeRetryMs.description: Wait before retrying a run a firewall challenged, 0-3600000 ms; null = 10 minutes, 0 = never

jobSpacingMs.description: Pause between this site's runs, 0-900000 ms; null/0 = none

pacingMs.description: Pause between a run's requests, 0-60000 ms; null = automatic

pluginRollback.description: WordPress: roll a plugin update back when it breaks a monitor

recoverStreak.description: Clean runs before a flaky monitor alerts again, 2-10; null = 5

rumIncludeOwnChecks.description: Count Relvato's own visits in real-user Web Vitals

name: update_site_settings
